YOUR QUESTIONS

Enjoy
peace of mind.

We answer your questions before your little friend’s stay.

All questions
Where do our feline and canine friends stay?

We do everything we can to make their stay comfortable in a detached villa in Koşuyolu. We welcome our feline friends on the upper floor of the villa and our canine friends on the lower floor. We take care to provide dedicated spaces for both.

We don’t restrict our feline friends’ free spirits, either. We provide space that suits their natural desire to do things their own way. Depending on their owner’s preference or their own, they can enjoy themselves in their own space or in shared areas.

Is anaesthesia used for pets receiving grooming services?

Even if our little guests are feisty or shy, we patiently complete their grooming and never use anaesthesia.

What are your opening hours?

We are open every day of the week from 09:00–18:30. Opening hours may vary on public holidays.

Please contact us on 0532 529 01 76 for check-in and check-out times, collection arrangements and pricing terms.
